comment:
* IkeKePayload represents a Key Exchange payload * *

This class provides methods for generating Diffie-Hellman value and doing Diffie-Hellman * exhchange. Upper layer should ignore IkeKePayload with unsupported DH group type. * * @see RFC 7296, Internet Key Exchange * Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2)

variables.name: DH_GROUP_1024_BIT_MODP_PUBLIC_KEY_LEN
variables.comment: Key exchange data length in octets

variables.name: CURVE_25519_X509_PUB_KEY_HEADER
variables.comment: Invariable header of an X509 format Curve 25519 public key defined in RFC8410

variables.name: KEY_EXCHANGE_ALGORITHM_CURVE
variables.comment: who has the same key exchange flow.

variables.name: keyExchangeData
variables.comment: Public DH key for the recipient to calculate shared key.

variables.name: isOutbound
variables.comment: Flag indicates if this is an outbound payload.

variables.name: localPrivateKey
variables.comment:
* localPrivateKey caches the locally generated private key when building an outbound KE * payload. It will not be sent out. It is only used to calculate DH shared key when IKE library * receives a public key from the remote server. * *

localPrivateKey of a inbound payload will be set to null. Caller MUST ensure its an * outbound payload before using localPrivateKey.

methods.name: public static IkeKePayload createOutboundKePayload(@SaProposal.DhGroup int dh, RandomnessFactory randomnessFactory)
methods.comment:
* Construct an instance of IkeKePayload for building an outbound packet. * *

Generate a DH key pair. Cache the private key and send out the public key as * keyExchangeData. * *

Critical bit in this payload must not be set as instructed in RFC 7296. * * @param dh DH group for this KE payload * @param randomnessFactory the randomness factory * @see RFC 7296, Internet Key Exchange * Protocol Version 2 (IKEv2), Critical.

methods.name: private static IkeKePayload createOutboundModpKePayload(@SaProposal.DhGroup int dh, RandomnessFactory randomnessFactory)
private static IkeKePayload createOutboundCurveKePayload(@SaProposal.DhGroup int dh, RandomnessFactory randomnessFactory)

* Encode KE payload to ByteBuffer.
     *
     * @param nextPayload type of payload that follows this payload.

methods.name: protected int getPayloadLength()
methods.comment:
* Get entire payload length.
     *
     * @return entire payload length.

methods.comment:
* Calculate the shared secret.
     *
     * @param privateKey the local private key.
     * @param remotePublicKey the public key from remote server.
     * @param dhGroup the DH group.
     * @throws GeneralSecurityException if the remote public key is invalid.
